summary: Iteration 7 testing complete for TableTaap. Backend (11/11 PASS via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py): GET /api/settings/customer-pin returns '1234' default; PUT validates (too-short '12'→400, non-digit 'abc'→400, too-long '1234567'→400, valid '5678'→200 persists); POST /api/auth/customer-login with correct PIN returns {success:true, token:'cust-...'}, wrong PIN→401 'Incorrect PIN'; POST /api/orders creates order with new status and is queryable; GET /api/subscription includes cycle_start, next_cycle_start, trial_start, trial_end (all populated for active trial); manager /api/auth/login with PIN 1234 returns 200 + mgr- token. Frontend (10/12 verified end-to-end via Playwright): Login page role cards present with .role-card class — customer-view-link (gold/orange themed, role-card-customer) + kitchen-view-link (green themed, role-card-kitchen), both clickable. /customer PIN gate blocks until correct PIN entered; wrong PIN stays gated, correct PIN unlocks menu grid. Customer cart Add→FAB→Drawer→Stepper→Table input→Place Order POSTs to /api/orders and drawer closes (verified in first Playwright run; the order #1029 with TEST_KitchenItem from backend test was visible on /kitchen ticket-grid). /kitchen page loads without auth, renders ticket-grid with Order #, Table, items+qty pills, time-ago, and ticket-advance-<n> button that successfully advances status via PUT /api/orders/{id} ('Order #1029 → done' confirmation toast observed). Subscribe page trial banner reads exactly "You won't be charged for the 4 days. Trial ends on 14 Jun 2026."; sub-cycle-dates row shows 'Started: 10 Jun 2026  Ends: 10 Jul 2026'. Payment brand chips present in all 4 groups: pay-brands-upi=[GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM]; pay-brands-card=[VISA, MC, RuPay]; pay-brands-netbanking=[HDFC, ICICI, SBI, AXIS]; pay-brands-wallet=[Paytm, MobiKwik, Amazon Pay, Freecharge]. Manager Profile shows profile-sub-dates with profile-sub-started='10 Jun 2026' + profile-sub-ends='14 Jun 2026' (trial end). Manager Settings → customer-pin-form visible with current-customer-pin readonly (default 1234), updating to '5678' persists and customer-pin gate accepts new value. Explore-mode-banner correctly HIDDEN when subscription.status='trial' (verified absence on /manager dashboard).

ui_bugs.issue: cart-fab is positioned bottom-right and the Emergent badge overlay (#emergent-badge) intercepts pointer events in automation. Real users on the deployed badge may experience a similar overlap on small screens. Suggest raising cart-fab z-index above 9999 and/or shifting position to bottom-left.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~886 lines — should be split into routers/{auth,customer_pin,menu,orders,stats,subscription,settings}.py. Carry-over from iter4/iter5/iter6.
Customer PIN stored plaintext in db.settings.restaurant.customer_pin — acceptable for low-risk customer flow but document the trade-off.

POST /api/auth/customer-login returns a cust-<uuid> token, but no other endpoint actually validates this token (i.e., POST /api/orders is open). Token is essentially decorative; either gate /api/orders behind it or document as open-by-design.
Customer.jsx ~400 lines mixing PIN gate, cart, drawer, menu grid — split into <CustomerPinGate/>, <CartDrawer/>, <CustomerMenuGrid/> for maintainability.

Manager.jsx explore-mode-banner uses inline subscription fetch — consider lifting subscription state into a SubscriptionProvider context so ProfileSection/SettingsSection/Subscribe all consume the same source-of-truth and don't re-fetch.

rca of the issue: Customer cart-fab click interception: the Emergent badge (a target=_blank <a id='emergent-badge'>) is fixed-positioned bottom-right with high z-index. The cart-fab is also fixed bottom-right. In Playwright they overlap and the badge intercepts pointer events for ~25s before timeout. Workaround in tests: use force=True (proven). Production fix: raise cart-fab z-index to >= 100000 OR move FAB to a non-overlapping anchor (bottom-left, or bottom-right with bottom: 80px to clear badge).
